title: Induistalize and Farm
description: This project takes advantage of the create mod and other tech mod and Farmers Delight to create a mod pack for players of all kinds. Build a gaint working factory, or spent your days in the kitchen making a nice meal for you and your friends.
body: This project takes advantage of the create mod and other tech mod and Farmers Delight to create a mod pack for players of all kinds. Build a gaint working factory, or spent your days in the kitchen making a nice meal for you and your friends. The adventure is up to you.
